items.question: Which Instagram accounts can I look up?
items.answer: InstaPSV is designed for supported public Business and Creator accounts. Public personal accounts may not resolve through this integration. Private accounts are not supported — the tool cannot bypass Instagram privacy settings.

items.question: Is InstaPSV free to use?
items.answer: Free accounts start with 6 search credits, enough for 3 successful profile lookups. A Pro plan ($5/month) removes the credit limit and enables downloads and eligible Story access. Payment is reviewed manually; access is not instant.

items.question: Are results always current and complete?
items.answer: No. Profile results can be cached for up to 24 hours, and the provider returns only a selection of media — not necessarily the complete post history. A missing result is not proof that content does not exist.

items.question: Can I view full Instagram Highlight collections?
items.answer: Full highlight collection retrieval is not currently implemented. The interface may show a cover image but cannot open and play through the complete set of stories inside a highlight. For full access, visit the creator's original Instagram profile.

items.question: Will I appear in someone's story viewer list?
items.answer: The search form does not connect to your personal Instagram account, so a named view is not logged on your behalf. However, this does not make your session fully anonymous — requests pass through InstaPSV infrastructure, and media may load from external hosts.

items.question: Can I download Instagram Reels or posts?
items.answer: Downloads are available on the Pro plan. The download saves the media file as supplied by the provider — quality depends on the source. InstaPSV does not remove watermarks or guarantee resolution. Obtain permission from the rights holder before republishing downloaded content.

items.question: Why does a public account return no results?
items.answer: Several factors can cause an empty result: the account may be a personal profile (not a Business or Creator account), the username may have changed, the provider may not cover that account, or a temporary rate limit may be active. A failed lookup does not mean the account blocked you or was deleted.

items.question: Does InstaPSV work with private Instagram accounts?
items.answer: No. InstaPSV can only display content from accounts that are publicly visible. It does not circumvent or bypass any privacy settings set by the account owner.

items.question: Is InstaPSV affiliated with Instagram or Meta?
items.answer: No. InstaPSV is an independent, third-party tool and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Instagram or Meta Platforms, Inc. Instagram is a registered trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.

items.question: What should I include when reporting a failed search?
items.answer: Send the public handle, the page URL, the approximate time, your browser, and the visible error message through the Contact page. Never send your Instagram password, access tokens, or private account content.
